references.context: Order theory: saturated finite chain under prime-ideal inclusion between fixed endpoints

references.phrase: all maximal finite chains have equal length and lengths are bounded above
references.disposition: Both equal-length and bounded-length clauses are explicitly stated; no Noetherian hypothesis is silently imposed.

review_rationale: Read catenarity across any comparable primes, using maximal finite prime chains connecting the endpoints and the stated boundedness of their possible lengths. This condition does not require R to be Noetherian.
